key_difference: (D) checks suitability at runtime by building an array of `qTryMetaTypeInterfaceForType` results and looping over it for nullptr, whereas (B) adds a compile-time `TypeIsSuitableForMetaType<T, UniqueType>` trait in `qmetatype.h` and branches with `if constexpr`, so (D) adds per-connect codegen (the null-check loop Fabian asked about) and its pointer and opaque-pointer handling depends on `qTryMetaTypeInterfaceForType` semantics rather than `IsPointerDeclaredOpaque`.
